title: Scale to 100K–1M MVs: sparse commits + table consolidation
description:
Goal: Support 100K–1M materialized views (segments) with mixed refresh-lag tiers (≈5s / 5min / 1h+) for CDP segment membership.

Execution tracks:
1) Baseline + instrumentation (metrics + simulation harness)
2) Sparse commits prototype (commit only dirty tables / group intersection)
3) Table consolidation spike (physical shard tables for cold tiers)

Runbook: use src/tests/simulation/ harness and add scenarios to validate scaling assumptions.

title: Track 1: Baseline + instrumentation for MV scaling
description: Objective: Establish baseline measurements for barrier scheduling/injection/collection + Hummock commit cost as MV/table counts scale. Add simulation harness scenarios and instrumentation hooks to quantify where the control-plane and persistence bottlenecks are.

title: Map barrier→commit path and add timing metrics
description: Locate and document the end-to-end path: barrier scheduling → injection → collection → CommitEpochInfo build → hummock_manager.commit_epoch. Add timing metrics/logs for: actor mapping build, inject RPC fanout, collect wait, commit_epoch breakdown, size of tables_to_commit, #sstables.

title: Add simulation scenario: many MVs + tiered barrier intervals
description: Extend src/tests/simulation/ to add a scenario that creates many MVs and runs with 3 tiers (≈5s / 5min / 1h) barrier/refresh cadence. Goal: baseline coordination + commit costs per tier.

title: Track 2: Sparse commits prototype (dirty tables only)
description: Objective: Make commit_epoch cost proportional to tables that actually changed (and later: changed ∩ group). Implement behind a config flag, add metrics, and validate with simulation harness scenarios.

title: Locate and shrink table_ids_to_commit to dirty tables
description: Trace how table_ids_to_commit is currently computed in barrier completion. Implement behind flag: derive CommitEpochInfo.tables_to_commit from dirty tables (present in new SSTs / deltas / watermarks) instead of committing all tables in scope.

title: Simulation: sparse writes across many MVs
description: Add simulation scenario that creates many MVs/tables but only updates a small subset. Verify tables_to_commit size stays near dirty set and commit latency remains stable as MV count increases.

title: Track 3: Table consolidation spike (cold-tier sharding)
description: Objective: Reduce table explosion by consolidating cold-tier logical tables into a bounded number of physical shard tables. Produce a design doc + minimal behind-flag prototype + simulation harness validation.

title: Design doc: table sharding for cold tier
description: Write a concrete design doc for consolidating cold-tier state into bounded physical shard tables. Cover key layout (physical_shard|vnode|logical_table_id|key), GC/compaction implications, stats accounting, migration/backcompat.

title: Prototype: shared physical shard table behind feature flag
description: Implement minimal prototype behind a flag for one internal table type: map many logical tables into one physical shard table with logical_table_id prefix. Add simulation validation.
